nodes.label: NE PM Tool HTML Shell
nodes.rationale: One HTML document titled NE PM Tool. React mounts at div#root and boots from the module script /src/main.jsx.

nodes.label: Backend Dev Requirements
nodes.rationale: Includes the runtime requirements via -r requirements.txt and adds pytest and httpx.

nodes.label: psycopg
nodes.rationale: Installed with the binary extra. The compose DATABASE_URL uses the postgresql+psycopg driver scheme.

nodes.label: Pydantic
nodes.rationale: Installed with the email extra.

nodes.label: PyJWT
nodes.rationale: Installed with the crypto extra for JWT signature verification.

nodes.label: Backend Service
nodes.rationale: Built from ./backend and published as host port 8001 to container port 8000. Health is HTTP GET /health. It waits for healthy Postgres and Keycloak.

nodes.label: CORS Origins
nodes.rationale: Allows the published app origins on port 5174 and the Vite origins on port 5173, for both localhost and 127.0.0.1.

nodes.label: Backend DATABASE_URL
nodes.rationale: postgresql+psycopg://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/pm. The hostname is the Postgres service. The database name is the literal pm, not ${POSTGRES_DB}.

nodes.label: Frontend Service
nodes.rationale: node:22-alpine runs the Vite dev server from the bind-mounted ./frontend tree on port 5173. CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING is enabled. node_modules is a named volume.

nodes.label: frontend_node_modules Volume
nodes.rationale: Named volume mounted at /app/node_modules so dependencies stay off the host bind mount of ./frontend.

nodes.label: Keycloak Bootstrap Admin
nodes.rationale: KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME and KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD create the initial Keycloak admin.

nodes.label: Keycloak Service
nodes.rationale: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.7.3 runs start-dev, persists in Postgres, and is published as host port 8082 to container port 8080. KC_HOSTNAME is http://localhost:8082.

nodes.label: KEYCLOAK_AUDIENCE
nodes.rationale: Expected token audience is backend-api.

nodes.label: KEYCLOAK_AUTHORIZED_PARTY
nodes.rationale: Expected authorized party is react-app.

nodes.label: KEYCLOAK_ISSUER
nodes.rationale: http://localhost:8082/realms/logic-silicon is the issuer browsers see on the published Keycloak port.

nodes.label: KEYCLOAK_JWKS_URL
nodes.rationale: Certs are fetched in-network at http://keycloak:8080/realms/logic-silicon/protocol/openid-connect/certs, while the issuer URL uses the host-published address localhost:8082.

nodes.label: logic-silicon Realm
nodes.rationale: Both KEYCLOAK_ISSUER and KEYCLOAK_JWKS_URL address the realm path /realms/logic-silicon.

nodes.label: Nginx Service
nodes.rationale: nginx:1.27-alpine publishes host port 5174 and loads ./nginx.conf. It starts only after backend and frontend are healthy.

nodes.label: nginx.conf
nodes.rationale: Mounted read-only as /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf.

nodes.label: Postgres Service
nodes.rationale: postgres:17-alpine. Readiness is pg_isready against POSTGRES_USER and POSTGRES_DB. Data is stored in ./data/postgres.

nodes.label: Postgres Data Volume
nodes.rationale: Host path ./data/postgres is mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data.

nodes.label: Postgres Connection Settings
nodes.rationale: POSTGRES_DB, POSTGRES_USER, and POSTGRES_PASSWORD configure the Postgres service. Keycloak's JDBC URL reuses all three. The API URL reuses the user and password and hardcodes the database name pm.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Stack
nodes.rationale: Local stack of Postgres, Keycloak, the API, the Vite frontend, and Nginx. Each service restarts unless stopped, and dependents wait until healthchecks pass.

nodes.label: Admin Role
nodes.rationale: An admin can also create, edit, and delete.

nodes.label: Alice
nodes.rationale: Demo account with the user role.

nodes.label: API
nodes.rationale: The API stores data in Postgres through DATABASE_URL so the database can live on another host.

nodes.label: API Docs
nodes.rationale: API docs are at http://localhost:8001/docs.

nodes.label: App URL
nodes.rationale: The app is served at http://localhost:5174. Passwords are entered on the Keycloak page.

nodes.label: Assignment
nodes.rationale: The project role is stored on the assignment and is not an extra authorization grant.

nodes.label: Bob
nodes.rationale: Demo account with the user and admin roles.

nodes.label: DATABASE_URL
nodes.rationale: The API connects through DATABASE_URL so the database can live on another host.

nodes.label: Docker Desktop
nodes.rationale: Docker Desktop is required to run the stack.

nodes.label: In-Memory Test Database
nodes.rationale: Tests use an in-memory database so they do not need Docker.

nodes.label: Keycloak
nodes.rationale: Sign-in is Keycloak. Passwords are entered on the Keycloak page rather than in the app.

nodes.label: Keycloak Admin Console
nodes.rationale: The Keycloak admin console is at http://localhost:8082/admin.

nodes.label: NE PM Tool
nodes.rationale: People directory and basic projects. The browser loads one React app. Sign-in is Keycloak. The API stores data in Postgres through DATABASE_URL so the database can live on another host.

nodes.label: Node.js
nodes.rationale: The first Keycloak setup also needs Node.js on the host.

nodes.label: Project Role
nodes.rationale: Lead, Member, and the other project roles are stored on the assignment and do not grant extra rights.

nodes.label: Pytest
nodes.rationale: Backend tests run with python -m pytest after installing requirements-dev.txt. They use an in-memory database and do not need Docker.

nodes.label: React App
nodes.rationale: The browser loads one React app. Passwords are entered on the Keycloak page.

nodes.label: Keycloak Realm Setup
nodes.rationale: After the services are healthy, npm run setup in test_example creates the realm. It is safe to run again.

nodes.label: User Role
nodes.rationale: A signed-in user can read.

nodes.label: Local PM Stack Ports
nodes.rationale: Ports 5174, 8001, and 8082 match a local PM stack. Stop that other stack first if it is already using them.
